contact.messageHint: Please don't include health details about your family.

about.title: About Thuluth
about.body: Thuluth helps families eat well following the Prophetic guidance of a third for food, a third for drink and a third for breath, alongside current nutrition science.
about.reviewersBody: Guidance is checked by qualified reviewers in these roles before release. Their names will appear here once their reviews are signed off.

clinical.title: Clinical nutrition reviewer
clinical.scope: Nutrition targets, medical safety rules and red-flag guidance

paediatric.title: Paediatric reviewer
paediatric.scope: Child growth, growth alerts and children's fasting

feeding.title: Feeding therapy reviewer
feeding.scope: Picky eating, autism support, ladders and food chaining

islamic.title: Islamic content reviewer
islamic.scope: Hadith sources, grades, fasting rulings and wording

urdu.title: Urdu language reviewer
urdu.scope: All Urdu text in the app and in help

privacy.title: Privacy and security reviewer
privacy.scope: Consents, data handling, exports and account deletion

about.sources: Every recommendation links to its sources, so you can see where guidance comes from.
